allowance: Reuse frozen H5 common-bank selector rules; no tuning after observing repeated outcomes. Long-horizon and repeated selection are distribution shifts, not covered by the calibration risk claim.
action_source: Fixed expert action sequence; only correction reacts to method's own observations. This is not a reproduced closed-loop Diffusion Policy.
short_horizon_control: Modify first five actions only, then replay remaining nominal actions. Evaluate same total physical time.
relinearization_control: Observed pose vs model-propagated pose; identical per-block controller optimizer and candidate generation. This measures response-model observation refresh, not Jacobian recomputation.
piecewise_control: Open-loop 20-action correction in four independent quintic blocks, 16 coefficients. Distinguishes reduced dimension from observation refresh.
long_suffix: Keep every original eligible state. Use min(10, remaining recorded actions); at least three exist. Report suffix duration and 10-action eligible subset separately.
